A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have determined the crystal structure of a pentenary Gal-T1 complex, which represents a structural snapshot of the enzyme in the transition state of the reaction.

we have determined the crystal structure of Gal-T1 in its open, Mn(2+), Mn(2+)+UDP-Gal, and pentenary complexes, and have shown how the enzyme coordinates its substrates and how it changes its conformation from an open to a closed form during catalysis.
